title: Comfort, features, and experimentation feedback
summary: This topic combines comments about comfort, driving feel, feature experimentation, and a few isolated usability or design observations, with many fragments too vague or context-limited for clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews highlight enjoyable drive modes, strong comfort, and a balanced mix of power and refinement.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback notes appreciation for the back-up assistant while implying the benefit is tied to difficulty reversing without it.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention handling, safety motivation, learning features, body and door-handle design, and general experimentation, but examples are too fragmentary to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: The topic is somewhat diffuse and mixes driving impressions, comfort, feature learning, design comments, and unrelated personal context.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, limiting confidence in a tighter thematic summary.
